Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR moves device-folder editing into the workspace picker and leaves only the selected folder name beside the composer. **Example:** Choose /workspace/field-notes on Design laptop at a 390 × 844 viewport. - **Before:** The selected folder still has an absolute-path editor and explanatory paragraph above the composer. - **After:** The workspace chip shows field-notes; reopening the picker allows changes, and canceling preserves the selected path. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Focused, useful change with inspected visual proof, relevant browser coverage, and no actionable findings; the inherited CI failure still prevents a green gate. | | **Proof confidence** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected before/after screenshots show the changed selected-folder presentation in the built Control UI at 390 × 844 with a simulated device; reported browser scenarios additionally exercise confirmation, cancellation, model blocking, and pending-create recovery. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Preference · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** A completed device-folder selection still looks like unfinished setup because its editor and explanation remain above the composer. **Reason:** Maintainer authorship establishes direction, and the focused interaction change removes clutter while retaining browsing, manual entry, cancellation, and model restrictions. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep open: this maintainer-authored PR delivers a useful, focused UI improvement with no actionable code findings; required CI remains red from a confirmed main-branch failure. **Priority:** P3 **Reviewed head:** `5fee7e4faec1db1a76c8d02e2a51fb98fd5a8327` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Control UI workspace picker collects a device-folder choice, commits it through the existing draft placement owner, and passes the unchanged deviceFolder payload to session creation. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Workspace picker] --> B[Browse or enter path] B --> C[Draft placement owner] C --> D[Selected folder chip] C --> E[Session creation] E --> F[Selected paired device] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep the existing draft placement owner and commit folder changes only through the picker’s confirmation action. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source retains the inline editor shown in the supplied before screenshots; no target code was executed during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The change is appropriately scoped: it reuses the picker and placement owner, removes the redundant editor and setter, and preserves the session payload and capability checks. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [2b46a6130923](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b46a6130923ef323f7ec0375c9c776d4b02a9b9). ### Provenance checked - `Device-folder selection and manual entry` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (2c87e333990141e6aa433fd05f1a82f09fca8a5e: Allow sessions to work directly in existing folders on explicitly selected paired devices.) - `Single device-folder menu choice and folder label` keeps the original intent (a506b3fb0a594564ba11a3856fc3368c2dfa4460: Replace overlapping device-folder choices with one short row, retaining browsing for admins and typed paths for other writers.) - `Compact picker layout and inline-editor wrapping` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (e80a6dd9fdb4c7ce724472dd5d1b216afb4e70a7: Keep placement controls compact and reachable while ensuring the inline device-folder form fits its row.) - `Lazy picker content and synchronous domain ownership` keeps the original intent (87a94c4b4236ccaded2cd75790032122037d5a66: Defer optional picker bodies while preserving existing state owners, focus, and loading behavior.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned change and clean checkout:** Reviewed the introduced merge-base-to-head diff; the screenshot revision and published head have identical trees, and the checkout remained clean. ([5fee7e4faec1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fee7e4faec1db1a76c8d02e2a51fb98fd5a8327)) - **Single commit boundary:** Manual edits stay in component-local draft state until confirmation; selectDraftDeviceFolder retains submission and pending-placement guards, clears competing project state, and closes the picker. ([`ui/src/pages/new-session/project-picker-content.tsx:64`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5fee7e4faec1db1a76c8d02e2a51fb98fd5a8327/ui/src/pages/new-session/project-picker-content.tsx#L64), [5fee7e4faec1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fee7e4faec1db1a76c8d02e2a51fb98fd5a8327)) - **Inspected visual evidence:** All four downloaded images were inspected. The clean and annotated comparisons show the built Control UI removing the persistent editor while retaining the selected field-notes chip, using synthetic content and a simulated device. ([`ui/src/pages/new-session/target-controls-view.tsx:259`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5fee7e4faec1db1a76c8d02e2a51fb98fd5a8327/ui/src/pages/new-session/target-controls-view.tsx#L259), [5fee7e4faec1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fee7e4faec1db1a76c8d02e2a51fb98fd5a8327)) - **Distinct browser contracts:** The updated browser scenarios cover manual confirmation and cancellation, browse selection, incompatible-model blocking, non-admin entry without directory listing, and restoration of the original pending-create payload. ([`ui/src/e2e/new-session-page.device-folder.e2e.test.ts:72`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5fee7e4faec1db1a76c8d02e2a51fb98fd5a8327/ui/src/e2e/new-session-page.device-folder.e2e.test.ts#L72), [5fee7e4faec1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fee7e4faec1db1a76c8d02e2a51fb98fd5a8327)) - **Inherited CI failure:** GitHub annotations for the PR job https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44943050611/job/136964691186 and scheduled-main job https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44935539101/job/136941599780 show the same Settings-search assertion receiving three Spanish results instead of two. https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/203201 owns the separate expectation correction. ([`ui/src/pages/config/settings-search.test.ts:26`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5fee7e4faec1db1a76c8d02e2a51fb98fd5a8327/ui/src/pages/config/settings-search.test.ts#L26), [5fee7e4faec1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fee7e4faec1db1a76c8d02e2a51fb98fd5a8327)) - **Existing feature and related work:** Current main retains the two-step selectDeviceFolder/setDeviceFolderPath interaction. https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169722 established device-folder sessions, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/203259 aligns the inline editor that this PR removes. ([`ui/src/pages/new-session/draft-place-state.ts:106`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/2b46a6130923ef323f7ec0375c9c776d4b02a9b9/ui/src/pages/new-session/draft-place-state.ts#L106), [2b46a6130923](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b46a6130923ef323f7ec0375c9c776d4b02a9b9)) ### PR surface Source +27, Tests +2, Docs +1.
